data.text:
Speech for Solapur GCV Mega Event
---

Dear GCV Community Leaders of Solapur, Maharashtra, India,

Namaste!

Thank you sincerely for inviting me to speak today. I am truly inspired by the strong and vibrant GCV spirit that is growing in India — and particularly here in Solapur.

I deeply commend your efficiency and determination in organizing not just one, but two major GCV events. Your ambition and dedication are setting a new standard for what is possible. India’s GCV movement is on fire — and it’s because of all of you.

I would like to recognize the incredible leaders who have made this event possible:

Mr. Phulari

Mr. Raaj Sharma

Mr. Swaymy Solapur

Mr. Rinku Singh

Mr. Vimal Varma

Mr. Vithhal Sharma

Mr. Mhaling Kanthale

Mr. Mahesh Bangalore

You are not just community leaders — you are true GCV Ambassadors, shining beacons for the Indian Pi Network. Your work sets a powerful example for all of us around the world.

We, at the Global GCV Core Team, stand firmly behind every Pioneer, community leader, and merchant who is building the GCV ecosystem. You have our full support.
---

⚖️ Strategy on Pi Payments

I am thrilled to see your acceptance and implementation of the GCV barter strategy:

For small items in limited supply — use 100% Pi.

For mid to high-value items — use partial Pi + partial fiat, with the rate clearly announced.

For daily barter — partial Pi is perfect.

For event promotions — offer selected small items with full Pi payment.

This structure allows flexibility while growing real usage of Pi. And I can tell you, this hybrid barter model is working across many African and Arab nations, and in Southeast Asia — including Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, China, Taiwan China, Vietnam, and Thailand, Cambodia etc.

This is how we have generated nearly 20 million GCV data on the blockchain — by making GCV part of our daily life and supporting local economies directly.
---

🔄 Why GCV Barter is NOT a Discount

Let me be clear — partial Pi + fiat payment is not a discount. A discount is a one-way sacrifice. But our barter model gives merchants a real chance to get the Pi value back through the GCV ecosystem.

If we all continue to generate GCV data, then the OM (Open Mainnet) Pi value will reflect our consensus, not the volatile exchange market price. This is the power of utility and ecosystem-driven value.
---

🪙 Pi: Asset or Currency? Both!

As Dr. Nicolas mentioned, we need to view Pi as a utility token. This means it is not merely a digital asset; it is a genuine digital currency intended for circulation and storage. Currency serves to measure assets and is considered an asset itself. This distinguishes it from typical assets, which are primarily for buying, selling, or utilization. Currency must have a fixed value since it is used to evaluate other assets. Consequently, the success of the Pi Network depends on having a GCV (Global Commercial Value) if it aims to promote the use of its utilities.

When we talk about Pi price, we treat it as an asset.

When we talk about Pi value, we treat it as a currency.

These are two very different concepts, but both are important. We still need the exchange market for liquidity and adoption, so more people can hold Pi. But as the ecosystem matures, Pi will eventually be convertible directly in the wallet, just like converting INR to USD.

We will move from “selling or buying Pi” to “converting Pi”, and the conversion rate can eventually be fixed — just like traditional Fiat conversion of currencies.

But for now, as we are still in pre-full OM stage, we must still refer to the exchange rate in our wallet. That’s okay. We are on the right path.
---

🎉 A Mega GCV Event Worth Celebrating!

I am so impressed by the range of products and services at today’s event. You offer over 20 different categories:

✅ Full Pi Payment:

Tea, biscuits, water, breakfast, fast food, bath soap, and more.

💱 Partial Pi Payment:

EN Wellness Healthcare

Vehicle insurance

LED TVs

Home & office furniture

Mobile phones

Two-wheelers and four-wheelers
Gold and silver

Jewelry

Absolutely incredible! These merchants are true pioneers. Please celebrate and publicize their names so more businesses can join. I’ll be proud to post their names on X (Twitter) to give them global recognition.
---

🙏 Final Thanks

Once again, thank you to the Solapur GCV team — and a special thanks to:

Global GCV Ambassador Mr. Soni Vijany — for your tireless work in building the Indian community.

Ms. Lumari (Executive Director)

Mr. Jojo (Executive Assistant)

Ms. Nonny Padja (Training Director)

And all our global GCV Ambassadors speaking today.

---

May today’s Mega GCV Event be a great success — and may India continue to lead as one of the world’s strongest forces in the GCV movement.

With deep respect and solidarity,

Doris Yin 🪷🪷🪷
Founder, Global GCV Movement
August 9th, 2025
